votes.motion: to approve the minutes from November 14, 2023
to approve the Preliminary Site Plan for Highlands South Lot 3 Pad C, a three (3) tenant commercial pad building located at 7836 South 5600 West subject to all the requirements of approval
to approve the Conditional Use Permit for a Restaurant, Fast Food (General) for Highlands South Lot 3 Pad C with the conditions and requirements of approval listed in this report

to approve the Preliminary Site Plan for the Wood Ranch Bistro building at 7188 West Hidden Hills Way subject to meeting all requirements Planning & Zoning Commission Meeting Minutes December 5, 2023 Page 4 of approval
to approve the Preliminary Subdivision Plat for the Jordan River Heights Subdivision subject to the requirements of approval 1 through 5 listed in the staff report

to forward a negative recommendation to the City Council for the proposed General Plan Amendment for Copper Meadows as the proposal fails to properly satisfy Criteria A, B, C, and E (13-7C-6). The motion was Planning & Zoning Commission Meeting Minutes December 5, 2023 Page 18

to forward a negative recommendation to the City Council for the Master Development Agreement/Plan for Copper Meadows as it is anticipated to have a negative impact on surrounding development, fails to comply with adopted ordinances, is not refined for adoption, and doesn’t provide sufficient detail or clarity on how and when utility deficiencies will be mitigated

to forward a negative recommendation to the City Council of the Rezone of 76.21 acres from Very Low-Density Single Family Residential (VLSFR), Public Facilities (P-F), and Low-Density Single Family (LSFR) to Planned Community (P-C) for Copper Meadows as the Planning Commission are unable to identify affirmative determinations for approval Criteria 1, 2 and 4 (13- 7D-6 (a))

to forward a positive recommendation to the City Council for the second option provided for the Text Amendment to Section 13-13-5: Water Efficiency Standards with the correction noted by Commissioner Winn

based on the information and findings of the required criteria set forth in the staff report and upon the evidence and explanations received today, to forward a recommendation of approval to the City Council for this application finding that an affirmative determination has been made for the criteria found in 13-7D-6B; 1 through 4, with the change to G. to state ‘character or use’
